vo_open.text: This bear served in the Polish army.

vo.text: In 1942, Polish soldiers in Iran adopted a bear cub, and named him Wojtek.
vo.cap: *1942, Iran:* Polish soldiers adopt a bear cub. *Wojtek.*

vo.text: He drank beer, marched on two legs, and slept next to the soldiers when it was cold.
vo.cap: He drank *beer*, marched on *two legs*, slept next to the soldiers.

vo.text: To keep him, they made it official. Wojtek was enlisted as a private.
vo.cap: To keep him, they made it official: *Private Wojtek.*

vo.text: At the Battle of Monte Cassino, he carried forty-five kilo crates of artillery shells. He never dropped one.
vo.cap: *Monte Cassino:* he carried *45 kg* crates of shells. He *never dropped one.*

vo.text: He was promoted to corporal. And a bear carrying a shell became his unit's emblem.
vo.cap: Promoted to *corporal.* A bear with a shell became the unit's *emblem.*
